summary: Zhongchao Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting held June 18, 2026. The meeting approved a massive increase in authorized share capital from US$20 million to US$10 billion, corresponding to a 500x increase in authorized shares, and authorized the board to implement one or more share consolidations with ratios between 2:1 and 250:1 over a three-year period. No specific transaction is announced—these structural amendments enable future flexibility. No price, premium, or advisor named. This is a governance filing, not a deal. Watch for subsequent board actions on consolidation or capital markets transactions.
